Eleventh closed beta of Verso.

## Reading

- New text settings: weight, contrast, word spacing, paragraphs, hyphenation
  and book styles.
- Line spacing now goes from 90% to 200%. It starts at 120%, so set it again
  if you used Tight or Loose.
- Hyphenation now follows each language's rules.
- Justified lines no longer squeeze words together.
- Punctuation can hang in the margin. It is on by default, with a switch in
  Settings under Advanced.
- After extending a selection, tap Done for all the passage actions, not
  just Highlight.
- Status messages appear as a small pill instead of a strip across the page.

## Updates

- What's new shows after an update, and can be reopened from Settings.
- Long release notes now split into pages.
